senses.gloss: m. (v. preced.; = h. פְּשִׁיעָה) indifference, willful negligence.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 22:8">Targ. Y. Ex. XXII, 8</cite> <he>בכו׳</he> (corr. acc.). Y. B. Mets. V, 10ᵇ bot. <he>מתה בב׳</he> if the animal died through negligence; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 5:10">Tosef. ib. V, 10</cite> <he>בבוסיא</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>בכ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 116b">B. Kam. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>בבו׳ וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>בכ׳</he>; Ms. M. <he>בבִיסְיָא</he>, <he>בבו׳</he>).
